CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: BHP is a global resources company with its Canadian operational headquarters in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan and global exploration headquarters in Toronto. BHP has a global workforce of approximately 90,000 people working in locations across Canada, Australia, Asia, the UK, US and the Americas. BHP produces commodities essential for global decarbonization, economic development and food security including copper, iron ore, steelmaking coal and is developing the Jansen potash mine in Saskatchewan, Canada.
